about: The effect catalog. The director picks effects from here and writes their words; reel_engine/effects.py checks them against these limits and the renderer draws them. Adding an effect = an entry here + its look (renderer/effects.js and, for picture effects, effects.PICTURE). layer: front (over everything), behind (under the speaker's cut-out; opaque = background replaced), picture (changes the footage itself), split (one part behind the speaker, one in front). fields: what the AI fills - texts (count and words per text), choice (one of a list), target (where on the speaker). captions: keep or hide while the effect is up.

doodle.title: Doodle Boy
doodle.use_when: a playful or emphatic line about the speaker themself or something they point at: a crown on 'I was the best', an arrow at the hand holding the thing, sparkles on 'magic', a question mark on doubt

headline_wall.title: Headline Wall
headline_wall.use_when: the speaker names something that is everywhere or blew up: news, a trend, a scandal, 'everyone is talking about it'

texts.meaning: news-style headlines about what is said, in the reel's language

orbit.title: Orbit
orbit.use_when: the speaker lists several things that surround them or that they juggle: skills, roles, worries, tools
orbit.avoid_when: fewer than three things are named

texts.meaning: the things named, one or two words each

glass_type.title: Glass Type
glass_type.use_when: a calm, premium statement worth framing: a principle, a definition, a quote

paper_cut.title: Paper Cut
paper_cut.use_when: a homely, crafty or storytelling line: a tip, a memory, a step in a process

texts.meaning: the label, one or two short lines

phone_mockup.title: Phone Mockup
phone_mockup.use_when: the speaker talks about an app, a message, a post, a search, going viral or what people see on their phones
phone_mockup.avoid_when: nothing about phones, apps or social media is said

texts.meaning: the text on the phone screen bar

cover_story.title: Cover Story
cover_story.use_when: a big reveal about the speaker or a person: an achievement, a transformation, 'this changed my life'
cover_story.avoid_when: the speaker is not on screen

texts.meaning: first the magazine name (one or two words), then up to three cover lines

ui_world.title: UI World
ui_world.use_when: notifications, messages, likes, followers, emails, money coming in, a busy online life
ui_world.avoid_when: nothing digital or social is said

texts.meaning: the text on each floating card: a notification, a message, a like count

framebreak.title: Framebreak
framebreak.use_when: the speaker breaks out of something or a big moment lands: escaping a rut, 'I quit', a bold claim
framebreak.avoid_when: the speaker is not on screen or the shot is wide

texts.meaning: an optional label on the frame

pullback.title: Pullback Reveal
pullback.use_when: a reveal: the camera starts tight on the face and pulls back as the point lands

zoom_through.title: Zoom Through Cut
zoom_through.use_when: a jump to a new idea or place at a cut: the camera rushes into the frame and out into the next shot. Mark the first word after the cut

vertigo.title: Vertigo
vertigo.use_when: a shock or realisation: 'and then it hit me', 'I couldn't believe it'

green_screen.title: Green Screen
green_screen.use_when: the speaker talks about a place or a world they are in or imagine: space, the city, nature, a stage, the office
green_screen.avoid_when: the real background already shows it

couch_wall.title: Couch Wall
couch_wall.use_when: a phrase the reel is built around: the speaker sits in front of a wall covered in that phrase
couch_wall.avoid_when: the phrase is longer than three words
